description: Approval of Details pursuant to Condition  4 (DETAILED DRAWINGS AND MATERIALS (DETAILS)) of Listed Building Consent ref: P2024/3324/LBC dated 24/03/2025 which gave consent for ‘Structural repairs to lower ground wall, alterations to lower ground floor to accommodate new wet room, replacement of rear door and window with new rear door and window, alterations to third floor to sub-divide existing bedroom to create 2no. bedrooms. Retrospective permission also sought for the construction of rear boundary wall and formation of door from the kitchen to rear garden’. Condition 4 relates to the details and materials of a window to the lower ground floor lightwell and a door at lower ground floor.
